audience: Solo operators running the whole company from one chat surface: scout, publish, reply, build, and money lanes with a human in the loop

bots.why: Chief-of-staff lane: routes every request, hands off via room/turn, posts the daily digest; performs no work itself.
Scout lane (repos): weekly triage of new above-the-bar repos into keep-or-dismiss, one line of reason each.
Scout lane (social): weekly built-something X posts with distinct authors, ranked by authors and never by impressions.
Publish lane: one post a week from something that actually happened; writes the post, publishes nothing.
Forge lane: the sixth playbook role and the gap this desk closes; its charter in templates/forge-desk.json is the contract.
Reply lane: a same-day first reply to every new inbound, left in Drafts under 120 words; sends none of them.
Money lane: each morning's failed payments and payouts with amounts and reason codes; never moves money.

human_steps: Paste each Bot's charter before trusting it; the charter is the contract, this desk is the seating chart.
In Settings → Plugins, click each connector on (X, Gmail, Stripe) and complete the browser auth. There is no connector-install API.

Run one Teach-a-task demo for the first routine (vendor flow, about ten minutes); ask the Bot in chat to create its routine, then confirm routines_with_runs moves 0 → 1. There is no routine-create RPC.
Confirm the first unattended run posted in chat before loosening anything: drafts stay drafts, money stays reported-not-moved.
Check current billing for plan eligibility before connecting paid connectors; no price is asserted here.
Never paste a secret into chat. Keys go on the variable card (secret-card-setup).
name: One-Person Company
policies: ONE-COMPUTER-SHARED: one shared cloud computer for every Bot on the account. Connect only the accounts this company needs, because a write here is a write in every other Bot's workspace.
DRAFT-ONLY-EXTERNAL: replies stay in Drafts and posts stay unposted until the operator sends or publishes. This desk never sends, posts, charges, or refunds.
DM-DOES-NOT-DELIVER: Bot-to-Bot DM does not deliver. Handoffs route via room/turn (see second-bot-router).

VENDOR-FLOWS-ARE-VENDOR-CLAIMS: unattended runs with the laptop closed, push/webhook delivery, and takeover prompts are vendor behavior, noted as such and never asserted as measured here. This desk claims only what a routine posted in chat.
NO-SECRETS-IN-CHAT: credentials are ${VAR} names on the variable card, never pasted.

routines.name: chief-digest
routines.prompt_hint: Post the digest: priority conflicts, handoffs made, noise in one line each, escalations with recommended call.

routines.name: discovery-sweep
routines.prompt_hint: Post the keep-or-dismiss list for the week's new above-the-bar repos, or one line: quiet week.

routines.name: pulse-report
routines.prompt_hint: Post the three to five built-something posts with distinct authors, what each built, and the link.

routines.name: weekly-post
routines.prompt_hint: Write the one post from the single most interesting real thing this week, then stop. Publish nothing.

routines.name: forge-status
routines.prompt_hint: Post the forge-lane status for the week per your charter, or one line: nothing to report.

routines.name: reply-sweep
routines.prompt_hint: Leave one draft reply under 120 words for each unanswered inbound, naming the next step with a date. Send nothing.

routines.name: money-check
routines.prompt_hint: Post FAILED with amounts, reason codes, and days failing, then PAYOUTS settled/in-transit/overdue. Both empty means one line: nothing failed.

tagline: Seven Bots, one shared computer, drafts before sends: the company runs, the human decides.
